title: Re-measure dollars per PR after the 11-09 cuts on 30 merged PRs
body:
Outcome: lead and subagent $/PR after #513 are re-measured on at least 30 merged PRs with `scripts/claude/spend-window.py`, and the roadmap is reranked from the result.
Why: t-5xvjxp7 (460c9b4) measured lead $2.39 -> $0.42 and subagent $2.03 -> $0.27 per PR, but on only 12 PRs after #513; the same-day slice (lead $0.84, subagent $0.32 over 50 PRs) shows the 12-PR window may flatter the cuts.
Proof: the task body records both windows with sample sizes; the roadmap PR cites them.
Scope: scripts/claude/spend-window.py, docs/program/roadmap.md.

Interim (2026-11-09 22:20Z, spend-window.py now also reads <dir>--krn-worktrees-* transcripts, +$0.13): after #513 (21:00Z..22:20Z) 24 PRs, lead $0.41/PR, subagents $0.22/PR, total $0.63/PR — the 12-PR window ($0.42/$0.27) held. Before #513: 19:00-21:00Z 25 PRs $0.32/$0.26; 11-09 00:00-19:00Z 48 PRs $1.32/$0.26; 11-08 41 PRs $4.84/$5.11. Close once >=30 PRs after 21:00Z: rerun `python3 scripts/claude/spend-window.py 2026-11-09T21:00:00Z <now>`.

Prices fixed (operator-checked table 2026-11-10): Sonnet 5.5 cache read $0.10 (was $0.20), Fable 5.2 $8/$40/$0.20 added, Haiku 5.5 prompts over 100K billed 5x. Window 21:00Z..06:55Z now reads 25 PRs at $2.10/PR because it includes the non-delivery Fable research and architecture sessions; close the task on a window that starts after those sessions or subtracts them.
